hooks.name: secret-scan-on-stop
hooks.description: Before the agent stops, scan changed files for leaked tokens. Confirm this v1 hook schema in the installed Kiro if the file does not load.

action.prompt: Review files changed in this session for leaked secrets: API keys, ingest tokens, bearer tokens, .env values, private keys, or credentials in source, tests, fixtures, docs, or logs. USECASECN_INGEST_TOKEN, LLM_API_KEY, and GITHUB_TOKEN must never appear in source or committed examples. If you find a leak, report the file and line and propose a redacted fix. Do not print the secret value. If there is no leak, say so in one sentence. Do not modify files unless a leak is present and the fix is an obvious redaction.
